# Giovanni Nicolazzo — research portfolio

- Canonical English profile: https://colazeta.github.io/en/
- Italian profile: https://colazeta.github.io/it/
- German profile: https://colazeta.github.io/de/
- Research CV: https://colazeta.github.io/cv/
- Person: Giovanni Nicolazzo, PhD in Criminology (2025).
- Doctoral thesis: The Criminal Component of the Legal Economy: A Study of Patterns Based on Actors — https://publicatt.unicatt.it/handle/10807/302862
- Research focus: criminal infiltration in the legal economy, corporate opacity, ownership structures, sanctions and anti-money laundering.
- Current research directions: criminal infiltration beyond mafia labels; ownership, hidden control and market effects; AML capacity in public institutions.
- Methods: structured and linked data, network and ownership reconstruction, proxy-based screening, case-based research and risk-indicator design.
- Public profiles:
  - https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5zc-vxQAAAAJ
  - https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5551-2682
  - https://github.com/colazeta
  - https://www.linkedin.com/in/giovanni-nicolazzo
- Contact: giovanni.nicolazzo@unicatt.it
- Selected publications and open research projects are listed on the profile and research CV.
